title: MV Remove Menu Options from Quest Journal

posts.author: Live2Kill
posts.body: Im using Yanfly Option Core and Quest Journal. Everything is going well except I noticed when going into your quests you have to click quests, available, scroll down from main quests. What im trying to do is remove where it says Main Quests, Side Quests Character Quests and Tutorial Quests but still make quests appear there.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
Make sure the version you use is the latest version, as previous can
have lower lines or more lines, so its best to look for the function
they showcased.
as ATT_Turan said, its either on line 2914 or on line 2910 dispite
some has the version 1.02, but the lines are different.
so if line 2914 doesn't work, move it to line 2910 and check again.
for me, its on line 2910, which reads
JavaScript:
if (questData.type === type) result.push(questId);

// make it read

if (type == "" || questData.type === type) result.push(questId);
and it should work.
2914 is for me a blank line.
